zh.title: 土耳其東部Sikorsky S-70直升機墜毀 4名土耳其軍職人員死亡
zh.summary: 4名土耳其軍職人員死亡，Sikorsky S-70直升機在Malatya外圍墜毀
body: 土耳其國防部表示，2026年11月12日，一架軍用 Sikorsky S-70 直升機在土耳其東部 Malatya 外圍墜毀，4名土耳其軍職人員死亡。
據當地媒體，直升機約於當地時間18時45分在 Malatya 的 Yeşilyurt 區一處社區墜落。警方、消防及醫療團隊到場處置。
土耳其國防部表示，墜機原因尚未查明。Malatya 首席檢察官辦公室已就事件展開調查；Anadolu Agency 報導，一名副首席檢察官和兩名檢察官已獲指派處理此案。

en.title: Four Turkish service members killed in military Sikorsky S-70 crash
en.summary: Four Turkish service members died in a military Sikorsky S-70 crash near Malatya on November 12, 2026.
body: Four Turkish service members died when a military Sikorsky S-70 helicopter crashed on November 12, 2026, on the outskirts of Malatya in eastern Turkey, the country’s Defense Ministry said.
Local media reported that the helicopter came down at about 18:45 local time in a neighborhood in Malatya’s Yeşilyurt district. Police, firefighters and medical teams responded to the crash.

The Defense Ministry said the cause had not yet been determined. The Malatya chief public prosecutor’s office opened an investigation into the crash. Turkey’s Anadolu Agency reported that a deputy chief prosecutor and two prosecutors had been assigned to the case.

zh.title: 5起獨立航空事件彙整：客艙煙霧、擋風玻璃破裂等
zh.summary: 五起航空事件包括客艙煙霧與鳥擊；另有走道「成了河流」及擋風玻璃破裂
body: The Aviation Herald報導的五起事件彼此獨立，沒有已述關聯。
1. Singapore的空中巴士A350-900（ICAO機型代碼A359）於2026年11月11日在Rockhampton附近出現客艙煙霧。
2. Frontier的空中巴士A321neo（ICAO機型代碼A21N）於2026年11月11日在芝加哥附近發生事件，走道被形容為「成了河流」。
3. Serve Cargo的波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於2026年11月10日在航程途中擋風玻璃破裂。
4. Antonov的A124（ICAO機型代碼A124）於2026年11月10日在名古屋離場期間有部件掉落。
5. Cathay的波音777-300（ICAO機型代碼B773）於2026年11月10日在倫敦發生鳥擊事件。

en.title: Aviation Safety Roundup Covers Five Independent Incidents
en.summary: Five independent aviation incidents include cabin smoke, an aisle described as a river, and a shattered windshield.
body: The Aviation Herald reports five independent incidents; no relationship among the events is stated.
1. Singapore’s Airbus A350-900 (ICAO type code A359) had smoke in the cabin near Rockhampton on November 11, 2026.
2. Frontier’s Airbus A321neo (ICAO type code A21N) was involved in an incident near Chicago on November 11, 2026; the aisle was described as “becoming a river.”
3. Serve Cargo’s Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) had a shattered windshield en route on November 10, 2026.
4. Antonov’s A124 (ICAO type code A124) dropped a part during departure at Nagoya on November 10, 2026.
5. Cathay’s Boeing 777-300 (ICAO type code B773) had a bird strike at London on November 10, 2026.

body: 3 independent aviation updates.

1. Zelenskyy says renewed Starshield speed cap hinders interception of Russian jet-powered drones
Zelenskyy says Starshield speed restrictions hinder Ukraine's efforts to intercept Russian jet-powered drones.

2. Poland is finalizing MiG-29 transfer plans to Ukraine for drone and counter-drone technology access
Poland is finalizing plans to transfer MiG-29 jets to Ukraine for drone and counter-drone technology access.

3. Airbus plans new Toulouse factory to produce engine pylons
Airbus plans a Toulouse engine-pylon factory; public consultation is scheduled to begin November 24, 2026.

facts.claim: On November 12, 2026, Zelenskyy said Starshield, the military-grade version of SpaceX’s Starlink satellite service, was again losing connectivity on equipment moving faster than 161 km/h in Ukraine.
facts.sourceQuote: Starshield, the military-grade version of SpaceX’s Starlink satellite service, is once again losing connectivity on equipment moving faster than 161 kilometers per hour (100 miles per hour) in Ukraine, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on November 12, 2026.

facts.claim: Zelenskyy said Ukrainian units had reported significant Starshield disruptions for several days across the front line and Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine.
facts.sourceQuote: In a post on X, Zelenskyy said Ukrainian units had reported “significant disruptions” to Starshield for several days across the front line and Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine.

facts.claim: Zelenskyy said the renewed cap was primarily disrupting efforts to intercept Russian jet-powered drones.
facts.sourceQuote: Zelenskyy said the renewed cap is primarily disrupting efforts to intercept Russian jet-powered drones.

facts.claim: Zelenskyy said some attacks had already succeeded because Ukrainian interceptors could not reach the necessary speeds while maintaining connectivity; he did not identify specific strikes.
facts.sourceQuote: Some attacks have already succeeded because Ukrainian interceptors cannot reach the necessary speeds while maintaining connectivity, he said, without identifying specific strikes.

facts.claim: Zelenskyy said the Ukrainian military investigated the disruptions and concluded they were systematic speed restrictions, not random errors.
facts.sourceQuote: According to Zelenskyy, the military investigated the disruptions and concluded they were “not random errors but systematic speed restrictions.”

facts.claim: The report says the restrictions’ start time and imposing party were not specified, while Kyiv was trying to establish the circumstances with the American side.
facts.sourceQuote: He did not say when the restrictions began or who imposed them, adding that Kyiv was “trying to establish all the circumstances with the American side.”

facts.claim: Poland is finalizing plans to transfer MiG-29 fighter jets to Ukraine in exchange for access to Ukrainian drone and counter-drone technologies.
facts.sourceQuote: Poland is finalizing plans to transfer MiG-29 fighter jets to Ukraine in exchange for access to Ukrainian drone and counter-drone technologies

facts.claim: Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk said on November 10, 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk said on November 10, 2026

facts.claim: The final terms of the exchange remain unclear, including which technologies Poland would receive.
facts.sourceQuote: The final terms of the exchange remain unclear, including which technologies Poland would receive.

facts.claim: Tomczyk announced that he had signed an agreement with Ukrainian Deputy Defense Minister Serhii Boiev to establish joint working groups on drone and counter-drone technologies.
facts.sourceQuote: Tomczyk also announced that he had signed an agreement with Ukrainian Deputy Defense Minister Serhii Boiev to establish joint working groups on drone and counter-drone technologies.

facts.claim: Polish officials first proposed exchanging MiG-29s for Ukrainian drone technology in December 2025.
facts.sourceQuote: Polish officials first proposed exchanging MiG-29s for Ukrainian drone technology in December 2025.

facts.claim: The arrangement stalled in June 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: The arrangement stalled in June 2026.

facts.claim: Airbus plans to build a new factory in Toulouse to produce engine pylons for its jets.
facts.sourceQuote: Airbus has announced plans to build a new factory in Toulouse to produce engine pylons for its jets.

facts.claim: The planned factory site is a 48-hectare greenfield site already owned by Airbus, in Cornebarrieu and close to Airbus’ main industrial complex.
facts.sourceQuote: The new plant will be built on a 48-hectare (118-acre) greenfield site, already owned by Airbus, in the municipality of Cornebarrieu, close to Airbus’ main industrial complex

facts.claim: Airbus’ main industrial complex is adjacent to Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS).
facts.sourceQuote: Airbus’ main industrial complex adjacent to Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS)

facts.claim: French media reports say investment in the new site is expected to be between €600 million and €900 million.
facts.sourceQuote: According to French media reports, the European aircraft manufacturer is expected to invest between €600 and €900 million in its new site

facts.claim: The first step toward construction is a public consultation scheduled to run from November 24, 2026, to February 16, 2027.
facts.sourceQuote: The first step towards its construction will be the launch of a public consultation process, which will run between November 24, 2026, and February 16, 2027

facts.claim: If all planning and regulatory requirements are met, construction could begin around 2029, with production envisaged for 2031.
facts.sourceQuote: If the project successfully fulfills all planning and regulatory requirements, construction could begin around 2029, with the start of production envisaged for 2031.
